claims.claim: Structural likelihood can validate N1002K function through the historical control panel.
claims.support: Candidate has the lowest N-to-K log odds among the 17 domain sites on all 24 WT weight/backbone combinations.
claims.challenge: Primary ordering passes 1/24; expanded ordering passes 0/24. D882N retains reported 2012/2020 endpoints but loses CENP-E phosphorylation in the 2019 study; labels are endpoint-specific.
claims.falsifier: A blinded, independently measured relevant control panel fails the proposed functional discrimination, or endogenous N1002K retains the claimed function.
claims.stop: No pathogenicity, stability or drug-branch promotion from this score. Preserve fixed historical labels and the endpoint conflict.
claims.reopen: Relevant endogenous abundance, localization and chromosome-attachment/segregation measurements with qualified controls.
claims.next_action: Predefine which endpoint each control validates; measure scaffolding and catalytic outputs separately.

claims.claim: A candidate score is robust to plausible structural input choices.
claims.support: WT backbones consistently give negative N1002K log odds.
claims.challenge: Using mutant-predicted backbones shifts the range from -5.696 to -5.389 to -2.780 to +0.463. Both rely on predicted domain geometry.
claims.falsifier: Independent structure/function evidence contradicts the proposed mechanism, or the conclusion depends on selecting one predicted backbone.
claims.stop: Do not choose the backbone/checkpoint that supports a preferred mechanism or equate probability with measured energy.
claims.reopen: Independent measurements constrain relevant conformation and functional consequences.
claims.next_action: Keep paired WT/mutant backbone sensitivity with all seeds and related checkpoints.

claims.claim: HT29 BUB1B cross-modal agreement is entirely a projection-fitting or failed-batch artifact.
claims.support: Symmetric held-out fitting and passing-CRISPR-only aggregation retain positive PRIME agreement; ten-PC ranks remain 1-6 and 1-3 within the stated smaller panels.
claims.challenge: One guide, tumour context, RNAi seed/potency uncertainty and post-hoc analysis remain. Projection can remove real biology; persistence can reflect a shared mitotic pathway.
claims.falsifier: Independent perturbation/restoration fails to reproduce a target-specific functional deficit after matched growth, viability and editing controls.
claims.stop: HT29 is an assay-development lead only; no relevant non-cancer or joint-treatment qualification.
claims.reopen: Independent guide or non-cutting perturbation, restoration and relevant non-cancer functional measurements.
claims.next_action: Keep HT29 counterevidence and qualify the perturbation before drug work.

claims.claim: MCF7 everolimus reversal qualifies a BUB1B rescue hypothesis.
claims.support: Reference-matching drug QC passes; MTOR mimicry remains rank 1, including with passing CRISPR profiles.
claims.challenge: BUB1B reversal attenuates with symmetric adjustment; no MCF7 BUB1B query survives QC. Passing drug QC is a separate property.
claims.falsifier: Qualified same-model joint treatment fails benefit or shows injury at justified exposures.
claims.stop: Do not zero-fill the absent query, transfer MTOR QC, combine cell types, or infer a clinical margin from nominal culture dose.
claims.reopen: New qualified BUB1B perturbation plus joint functional treatment evidence and justified exposure/safety margins.
claims.next_action: Retain everolimus only as an optional model-qualified mechanistic probe.

claims.claim: Successful optimized compute provides biological validation.
claims.support: All eight H100s completed 67584 fixed-site samples and 820147416 expression comparisons; the toolkit was executed with recorded pins and controls.
claims.challenge: One stock/exact pilot is bounded; source experiments, checkpoint families, backbones and decoding orders are dependent. The structural controls largely fail.
claims.falsifier: Source/output reproduction or numerical controls fail, or measured biology contradicts the model.
claims.stop: Software success cannot open a biological gate or resolve phase, exposure or clinical benefit.
claims.reopen: Independent biological evidence plus reproducible technical provenance.
claims.next_action: Retain failure logs, complete matrices, all outcomes and explicit limits on measured GPU utilization.
